cohort: Two women, one primigravida and one multigravida with twin gestation, who developed paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia within hours of caesarean delivery.
finding: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) can occur in the immediate postpartum period, particularly following caesarean section, warranting high clinical suspicion and prompt management for safe maternal recovery.
mod_finding: The cases highlight the occurrence of SVT in the immediate postpartum period following caesarean section.
